subject: callback URL for google auth sends default port as part of string

messages.author: c5f0e942d7a14dbd
messages.subject: callback URL for google auth sends default port as part of string
parts:
i'm trying to evaluate r shiny pro for a project and find the following unexpected behavior.

shiny-server.conf has shiny listening on port 80, not the default 3838. this is behind apache as reverse proxy, which works fine.

when enabling google auth for a specific location, the callback url contains the default port even though the config isn't using it. 3838 isn't exposed to the world, so the exchange fails.

is this port defined statically in javascript somewhere? i haven't found where this is coming from at all yet.

i'm running this in centos 7 docker containers for now with the shiny-server-commercial-1.5.3.770-rh6-x86_64.rpm installed.

any help on this would be great.
